CLI release.

- Security integration (LDAP) users could not authenticate on the non-MySQL channels. [#79165](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/79165)
- `CAST(x AS CHAR(N))` now truncates the result to `N` characters, consistent with MySQL. Both constant folding in the FE and execution in the BE apply the truncation. [#75909](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/75909)
- `ViewsSystemTable` held a database read lock instead of an intensive table lock. [#78344](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/78

- Internal statistics DML now binds its own context, so `DROP STATS` in an external catalog session no longer reports `Unknown database '_statistics_'`. [#80473](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/80473)
- Explicit `CAST(x AS CHAR(N))` now truncates the result to the first `N` characters, consistent with MySQL. [#75909](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/75909)
- `information_schema.views` queries failed when Ranger authorization was enabled because of a database-wide read lock. [#78344](h

- Elasticsearch external tables and Elasticsearch catalogs rejected clusters running version 8 or 9 with `Unsupported/Unknown ES Cluster version`, and concurrent queries could overwrite each other's request URL parameters, which surfaced as unrelated analysis errors such as `Column 'id' cannot be resolved`. [#78267](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/78267) [#79391](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/79391)
- `TRUNCATE TABLE <external_catalog>.<db>.<table>` now checks the `DELETE` privileg

- Elasticsearch external tables and Elasticsearch catalogs rejected clusters running version 8 or 9 with `Unsupported/Unknown ES Cluster version`, and concurrent queries could overwrite each other's request URL parameters, which surfaced as unrelated analysis errors such as `Column 'id' cannot be resolved`. [#78267](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/78267) [#79391](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/79391)
- Background auto-ANALYZE of an external table could fail with `primary key size ex

- Range-colocate fixes: stopped an alignment job storm and fail-close unaligned colocate joins, fixed null-safe joins dropping matches under bucket-shuffle, and improved range-colocate join detection in plan feedback. [#75930](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/75930) [#76104](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/76104) [#76121](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/76121)
- Materialized view pinned-range maps are now keyed correctly (by table UUID), fixing MV bootstrap pinning being d

- MySQL result serialization no longer uses per-row virtual dispatch; a typed column writer is built once per chunk, reducing serialization overhead for wide or large result sets. [#66316](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/66316)
- `_statistics_.pipe_file_list` internal table was not re-created after the `_statistics_` database or table was dropped. [#73970](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/73970)
- Added missing MySQL 8 columns to `information_schema` tables to improve compatibility wi

* `information_schema.COLUMNS` always returned `NULL` for `DATETIME_PRECISION`, breaking MySQL-protocol clients that derive column size from that field. [#74623](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/74623)
* `DROP PERSISTENT INDEX` modified `rebuildPindexVersion` without a table lock; `RestoreJob` post-restore mutated MV base-table info under only a DB READ lock; `FinalizeCreateTableAction` passed a DB-level lock across iterator creation. [#74968](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/74968)
*

- Fixed Arrow Flight Prepared Statement forwarding sending the wrong action-type string when a request is forwarded to a different FE, which caused every ADBC client using prepared statements behind a load balancer to fail. [#76310](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/76310)
- Several dependency CVEs: excluded an unused `avro-ipc` dependency that bundled a vulnerable jQuery 1.4.2; bumped Netty to 4.1.136.Final; excluded vulnerable Jetty jars and bumped pgjdbc to 42.7.12; bumped Apache Thrift to 0.24

- Addressed security vulnerabilities (CVE): upgraded Thrift to 0.24.0 and Netty to 4.1.136.Final, bumped the PostgreSQL JDBC driver to 42.7.12, and removed vulnerable transitive dependencies that shipped alongside their fixed counterparts, namely `bcprov-jdk15on`, the end-of-life OkHttp 2.x line, `avro-ipc` (which bundles jQuery 1.4.2), and the Jetty client and security jars. [#76922](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/76922) [#76555](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/76555) [#76783](http

- Added the FE metric `txn_max_committed_pending_publish_ms`, a per-database gauge reporting the longest time a committed transaction has been pending publish, to help diagnose stuck or lagging version publishing. [#75025](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/75025)
- `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS` on Iceberg REST catalogs now succeeds silently when the database already exists, instead of raising an error. [#75017](https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/pull/75017)

A differential campaign ran about 1,600 queries against SQLite 3.51 and DuckDB 1.2 and fixed every case where both engines agreed and Stoolap differed (#94, #92, #93, #95, #97):
- Swallowed durability errors in tombstone renames, PK cleanup and manifest loading now fail loud (#32), and a database whose cold volumes cannot be reloaded fails closed instead of opening on partial data (#35).
- Dialect kept as before and documented: NULLs sort first on DESC and last on ASC (PostgreSQL rule); backslash is an esca

Existing v0.3.7 databases are automatically migrated on first open:
UPDATE on primary key columns is now rejected with a clear error message. The engine uses `row_id == pk_value` as a core invariant across ~50 code paths. This matches SQLite's behavior for rowid tables. Use `DELETE + INSERT` to change a row's primary key value.
- CLI error paths ensure database cleanup before exit

# Apache Pinot 1.5.1

Apache Pinot 1.5.1 is a **security patch release** based on 1.5.0. It contains only dependency updates and dependency-exclusion changes to resolve reported CVEs — **no functional, API, configuration, or wire-format changes**. A vulnerability scan of the 1.5.1 binary distribution reports **0 critical and 0 high** findings.

This addresses the CVEs reported in #18593, plus additional Jetty, BouncyCastle, and commons-configuration2 findings surfaced during release verification.
